date_note: The page gives only its publication day (23 November); the sentencing day is not stated.
title: Peruvian call center operator sentenced to eight years over government-impersonation scam
geo_basis: country only; the article names no court or district
summary: BleepingComputer reports that Carla Magaly Alcedo Mendoza, of Lima, Peru, who pleaded guilty to conspiracy to commit mail and wire fraud, was sentenced to eight years in prison. According to the Justice Department, quoted by BleepingComputer, the scheme defrauded more than 30,000 Spanish-speaking residents of the United States out of $15 million. Callers posed as US officials and lawyers, the article says.
plain: A Peruvian call center operator got eight years in prison for a scam in which callers posed as US officials, the Justice Department says.
exec: Enforcement against a call-center fraud network that targeted Spanish-speaking US residents.
